record.paper_title: The Quest for Equational Axiomatizations of Parallel Composition: Status and Open Problems
record.original_question: For process algebras whose language includes parallel composition with synchronization, such as ACP, find equational axiomatizations for bisimilarity that are omega-complete.

artifact.status_search_result: Recent surveys and research on equational axiomatizations of parallel composition indicate that, while ω-complete axiomatizations are known for fragments such as PA (interleaving without communication) and finite axiomatizations of bisimilarity exist for ACP/CCS extended with left- and communication-merge, the problem of producing an ω-complete equational axiomatization of bisimilarity for process algebras with parallel composition with synchronization (ACP-style) remains open. Work as recent as 2021–2022 (e.g., on whether two binary auxiliary operators are necessary) continues to investigate related axiomatizability questions without resolving ω-completeness in this setting.

status_evidence.title: Are Two Binary Operators Necessary to Obtain a Finite Axiomatisation of Parallel Composition?
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates finite axiomatisability of parallel composition with auxiliary operators; related ω-completeness questions for ACP-style synchronization remain unresolved.
status_evidence.claim: The axiomatization landscape for parallel composition with synchronization is still an active area with open ω-completeness questions.

status_evidence.title: The Saga of the Axiomatization of Parallel Composition
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of results on equational axiomatizations of parallel composition, identifying ω-completeness over ACP-like calculi with synchronization as an open problem.
status_evidence.claim: ω-complete axiomatization of bisimilarity for ACP with synchronization is identified as open.

status_evidence.title: A New Strategy for Proving omega-Completeness applied to Process Algebra
status_evidence.snippet: Provides ω-completeness for PA (interleaving without communication) but does not settle the case with synchronization.
status_evidence.claim: ω-completeness is established for parallel composition without synchronization, leaving the synchronization case open.
